releases.notes:
## What's Changed in Antidote v1.3.0

### The Wandering Monk (Spiritual Healer Entity)
- **New Entity**: Added the peaceful ntidote:wandering_monk hermit with tonsure styling, earthen habit robe, and travel sandals.
- **Sacred Cleanses**:
  - **Blessed Bread of Relief**: 5 Bread -> Cures 1 random active affliction (limited to 3 purchases per visit).
  - **Fruit of Enlightenment**: 20 Bread + 2 Honey Bottles -> Cures all 30 afflictions, resets disability timer, and refunds 2 empty glass bottles (limited to 1 purchase per visit).
- **Pacifist Defense**: If attacked, drops a holy smokescreen (blinds/slows attacker for 5s) and teleports up to 16 blocks to safety.
- **Departure Ceremony**: Rings church bell, swirls campfire incense smoke & golden sparkles, and departs 3 seconds after trade completion.
- **Spawner Schedule**: Escalating cumulative curve over 2.5 Minecraft days (0% at 2 min up to 99% at 50 min).
- **Server Optimization**: Entity scan runs only during the 1-minute interval checks for zero tick overhead on multiplayer servers. Exactly 1 monk exists globally at a time.
- **Admin Commands**: Added /antidote monk spawn, /antidote monk status, and /antidote monk reset.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/leanwell/antidote-mod/compare/v1.2.0...v1.3.0

releases.notes:
### Overview
Antidote v1.1.1 is a hotfix release that resolves the natural world generation of the Medical Vending Machine inside village churches.

### Bug Fixes
- **Village Church Generation**: Fixed an issue where the Medical Vending Machine was not naturally generating inside village churches when loading new chunks.
- **Dynamic Structure Placement**: Implemented a structure piece placement hook (PoolElementStructurePieceMixin) that detects village church templates (plains_temple_3, desert_temple_1, etc.) across all village biomes (Plains, Desert, Savanna, Taiga, and Snowy), locates the brewing stand altar, and intelligently places the 2-block machine on solid floor against the church wall with proper facing.
- **Duplicate Prevention**: Added boundary and vicinity checks to guarantee that only one vending machine generates per church.

### Requirements
- Minecraft 26.3
- Fabric Loader >= 0.20.1
- Disabilities Mod >= 0.5.0

---
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/leanwell/antidote-mod/compare/v1.1.0...v1.1.1

releases.notes:
### Overview
Antidote v1.1.0 introduces the **Medical Vending Machine**, a 2-block emergency medical station generating naturally in village churches, featuring direct-inventory checkout, an interactive in-game Recipe Library, and real-time affordability indicators.

### What's New
- **2-Block Medical Vending Machine**: Generates in village churches across all village biomes; mineable with an Iron Pickaxe or higher.
- **Direct Inventory Checkout**: Automatically scans and deducts Emeralds and Diamonds from your inventory upon checkout.
- **Affordability Indicators**: Real-time green borders for items you can afford and red borders for items lacking currency.
- **Interactive Recipe Library**: Dedicated in-game catalog tab displaying lore descriptions, crafting recipes, and direct-purchase options for all 31 antidotes.
- **Visual & Audio Polish**: Custom 16x16 item sprite, redesigned 2-block block textures, transaction audio cues, and solid-black UI typography without drop shadows.

### Fixes & Improvements
- Added missing localization for the vending machine item (item.antidote.medical_vending_machine).
- Added word-wrapping to prevent lore text clipping in the Recipe Library panel.
- Fixed 2-block placement and breaking synchronization to eliminate item duplication bugs.

---
**Pull Request**: https://github.com/leanwell/antidote-mod/pull/1 by @leanwell
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/leanwell/antidote-mod/compare/v1.0.0...v1.1.0

releases.notes:
# Antidote v1.0.0 for Minecraft 26.3 (Fabric)

Initial release of Antidote, a companion mod for the Disabilities mod by OddSense. Antidote introduces 30 condition-specific craftable antidotes and a legendary God Antidote to cure active conditions and reset assignment timers.

---

## Required Dependency & Credits

- Notice: Antidote requires the [Disabilities](https://modrinth.com/mod/disabilities) mod (>=0.5.0) by OddSense.
- All credit for the Disabilities mod and its condition mechanics goes to OddSense.

---

## Key Features

- 30 Condition-Specific Antidotes: Shapeless crafting recipes using thematic vanilla ingredients to cure specific permanent disabilities.
- God Antidote: High-tier cure-all crafted from a Nether Star and Totem of Undying that clears all active disabilities and resets the assignment timer.
- Dynamic Layered Visuals: Custom item textures with dynamic color tinting matching each condition.
- Empty Bottle Recycling: Returns an empty glass bottle to the player inventory upon consumption.
- Audio & Particle Feedback: Unique sound effects and particle bursts (including Totem effects for the God Antidote) with action bar confirmation messages.
- Custom Creative Tab: All 31 antidotes organized under the Antidotes creative mode tab.

---
